title: Piecewise smooth stationary Euler flows with support in a neighborhood of a helix
summary: We construct stationary solutions of the three-dimensional incompressible Euler equations with helical symmetry and support in a neighborhood of a helix. The solutions are piecewise smooth and arise from a nonlinear overdetermined elliptic boundary value problem associated with a stream-function formulation.
